youtube_short.title: Grocery Stores Engineer Your $1,600 Food Waste
title_alternatives: Why You Throw Away $1,600 in Food Every Year
3 Tricks Stores Use to Make You Waste Food
youtube_short.description: You're not bad at grocery shopping — stores spend billions making sure you overbuy. The average family wastes $1,600 in food every single year, and it's not an accident. Bulk packs get you to buy 50% more but you only eat 30% more. Loss leaders like cheap milk and eggs pull you in the door so you grab 6 things you never planned on. And expiration dates? Those are set by retailers — 80 billion pounds of perfectly good food gets tossed because of a number they chose. Track what you throw away for one week and you'll start saving $800 before year-end. #moneytips #personalfinance #foodwaste — Follow for more money psychology breakdowns.
